[P2] Return to one supported evidence contract

Rule 2, **Simplify before you add**, is unmet: this negotiates multiple reader APIs even though `verify_checkout()` permits exactly one revision. Similar compatibility branches appear in cleanup and summary, without an explanation of why binding directly to the selected contract cannot work. The committed pin also skips the new replay policy, while consumer tests conditionally bypass unsupported checks. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and agree on one validated producer/reader contract; a single fixed interface is the simpler direction.
